sources.citation: Marino et al., Predicting the success of new crypto-tokens: the Pump.fun case, arXiv:2602.14860v1
sources.event_outcome: Pump.fun bonding-curve graduation at approximately 85 real SOL
sources.pit_status: Author states all predictors are constructed from evidence available at the current curve state
sources.main_finding: Real SOL curve state is the baseline; fast capital accumulation through fewer trades is strongest, bot-like share is adverse later, historically successful traders add modest non-monotonic information
sources.limitation: One month and one platform regime; graduation is not an actionable return; data/code are not released
sources.license: Paper under arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license; underlying data unavailable

sources.citation: Hu et al., MELT: A Behavioral Trace Dataset for High-Risk Memecoin Launch Detection, arXiv:2602.13480v2
sources.sample_size: 41k+ migrated launches; 200M+ parsed transactions; 122 behavioral features
sources.event_outcome: Risk annotations for migrated launches using price drop, insider behavior and structured swap/wash/transfer/mint/bundle traces
sources.pit_status: Mixed: raw traces are timestamped; several published aggregate features/labels require explicit decision-time reconstruction
sources.main_finding: Typed behavior and entity-linked bundle traces expose hidden concentration; coordinated accounts hold 36.5% of supply on average
sources.limitation: Conditions on migration, so it is survivor-selected for launch-wide inference; raw source exceeds 1 TB; commercial model use is prohibited without permission
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for repository/data; arXiv paper is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0

sources.citation: Li et al., Catching the Rug: Early Prediction of Fraudulent Memecoins on Solana via Machine Learning, arXiv:2608.20271v1
sources.event_outcome: One-hour TVL-withdrawal and trading-idleness rug definitions predicted from the first five minutes
sources.pit_status: First-five-minute aggregates are temporally bounded, but rows already rugged inside that window are dropped and must not be treated as an unbiased population
sources.main_finding: Classic boosted trees outperform or match deeper tabular models; platform transfer degrades and fused training partly mitigates domain shift
sources.limitation: Public paper does not provide a downloadable dataset/code release; label definitions are behavioral proxies and omit bundle resolution
sources.license: Paper CC BY 4.0; dataset/code availability not established

sources.citation: Alhaidari et al., SolRPDS: A Dataset for Analyzing Rug Pulls in Solana Decentralized Finance, arXiv:2504.07132
sources.sample_size: 3.69B source transactions; 62,895 suspicious pools; 22,195 rug-pattern tokens
sources.event_outcome: Liquidity-add/remove, inactivity and withdrawal-pattern rug evidence
sources.pit_status: Timestamped event data can be reconstructed PIT; published terminal classification itself is an outcome
sources.main_finding: Liquidity trajectories and withdrawal/inactivity are useful failure evidence
sources.limitation: Predates Pump.fun-dominant regimes and is transferable-risk evidence only

sources.citation: Chen et al., From Hype to Collapse: Investigating Rug Pull Scams on Solana, arXiv:2603.24625v2
sources.sample_size: 100,063 new tokens; 117 confirmed benchmark rugs; 76,469 pipeline candidates
sources.event_outcome: Freeze-authority abuse, liquidity withdrawal or pump-and-dump within a conservative behavior-guided label pipeline
sources.pit_status: Raw events are temporal; labels and six-month checks are future outcomes and cannot be features
sources.main_finding: Rugs are short-lived and activity is first-day concentrated; organized groups recur
sources.limitation: High-precision 24-hour labels intentionally omit slower three-to-seven-day rugs; no separate reusable license was found
sources.license: Paper under arXiv perpetual non-exclusive license; released dataset license not stated in the paper

sources.citation: Kamat, Pump.fun Graduation Regime Windows, corrected arXiv:2607.02823v3
sources.sample_size: 860,213 released launches; 832,941 usable outcomes; 1,651 observed graduations
sources.event_outcome: Fast-regime graduation observed by a top-50 newest polling collector
sources.pit_status: Launch metadata is PIT, but effective outcome coverage ends around six minutes; nominal 24-hour timeouts are not valid 24-hour non-graduations
sources.main_finding: Social-channel presence and above-default initial state discriminate fast graduation, but effects are non-causal; virtual market cap cannot substitute for real reserves
sources.limitation: Severe outcome-dependent coverage loss; all reported rates are lower bounds for full 24-hour graduation

sources.citation: Kamat, Coordinated Sniper Cohorts on Pump.fun, arXiv:2607.02795
sources.sample_size: 1,578,333 buyer observations; 166,098 launches; 1,012 persistent cohorts; 2,965 addresses
sources.event_outcome: Early-buyer co-occurrence cohorts and first-30-minute buyer/SOL flow
sources.pit_status: Early observations can be PIT; persistent cohort identity must be learned from history strictly before each decision
sources.main_finding: Cohort-touched launches have higher flow, but an activity-matched placebo has a larger lift, refuting naive cohort-causal bullish interpretation
sources.limitation: Two weeks, no actionable return outcome, residual launch-quality confounding

sources.citation: Anastasopoulos et al., Order flow and cryptocurrency returns, Journal of Financial Markets 79 (2026) 101047
sources.pit_status: Lagged forecasting design; source data available only on request
sources.main_finding: World order flow predicts returns and can dominate economic fundamentals, particularly in nonlinear models
sources.limitation: Daily/weekly established-asset evidence does not establish seconds/minutes launch-token effects

sources.citation: Cookson et al., The Social Signal, Journal of Financial Economics 158 (2024) 103870
sources.sample_size: Comprehensive firm-day panel across three investor networks
sources.event_outcome: Next-day abnormal equity returns and retail order imbalance
sources.main_finding: Attention and sentiment are distinct: common attention predicts reversal/negative next-day returns while sentiment predicts positive returns; source and user population matter
sources.limitation: Equity firm-day evidence is not direct evidence for new memecoin launches

sources.citation: Maitre, Weigert and Pugachyov, Twitter-Based Attention and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns, SSRN 5010136
sources.sample_size: Cryptocurrency-day panel; exact count is not stated on the abstract page
sources.pit_status: Abnormal attention is current log post count minus trailing 30-day average
sources.main_finding: Investor ticker-post attention, not official-channel posts, drives return predictability; attention and source type must be separated
sources.limitation: Daily established-asset panel; confidential/proprietary Twitter history; not minute-scale launch evidence
sources.license: SSRN author manuscript; underlying social data not released

sources.citation: Solana Tracker Data API, PnL V2 wallet and token-position documentation
sources.dataset_dates: Live provider-defined history; no completeness start date is documented
sources.event_outcome: Wallet/token position, realized/unrealized PnL, trades, identity and market snapshot
sources.pit_status: Current API responses are not historical PIT snapshots unless captured at decision time
sources.main_finding: strict mode zeros invalid-PnL rows, adjusted mode caps them, raw leaves them untouched; identities label developer, bot, arbitrage, hacker, pool and spam wallets
sources.limitation: Requires an API key; provider labels and PnL heuristics need independent validation; current lifetime PnL leaks future knowledge in replay
sources.license: Commercial API terms; no right to redistribute provider data is assumed
